name: phr-foundry
description: PeoplesHR internal Claude Code marketplace. Distributes organization standards and tooling to engineering teams.

plugins.name: org-standards
plugins.description: PeoplesHR product knowledge for every role. Ships the phx-product-context skill, which retrieves PeoplesHR module behaviour, known findings, design documents and user documentation from the WeKnora knowledge bases through the weknora-peopleshr-product-knowledge MCP server you connect yourself. Developers doing solution engineering and Business Analysts writing a PRD or eliciting requirements both install it. The hands-on build skills live in dev-kit, the FRD skill in ba-kit, and the SQL standards review and phx-dbexplorer in dba-kit.

plugins.name: dev-kit
plugins.description: PeoplesHR developer build tooling. Ships the hrm-deployment-script skill for reformatting SQL to PHR conventions in .NET Framework projects, the hrm-notification skill for building a Job Scheduler email notification for any module, the phx-debugger skill for fixing an Azure DevOps bug end to end from its bug ID, the hrm-configuration-document skill for writing the house Configuration Document (.md, .docx, PDF) for a finished CR, and the phx-write-sdd skill for authoring the Architecture / Solution Design Document (SDD) against the template held in the PHR-X project wiki. Install org-standards alongside it for phx-product-context, and dba-kit for the phx-dbexplorer MCP server if you want schema browsing.

plugins.name: ba-kit
plugins.description: PeoplesHR tooling for Business Analysts. Ships the phx-write-frd skill for authoring the Feature Requirements Document (FRD) against the template held in the PHR-X project wiki. phx-write-frd needs your own Azure DevOps MCP server. Business Analysts also install org-standards, which ships phx-product-context.

plugins.name: dba-kit
plugins.description: PeoplesHR database tooling for DBAs. Ships the phx-sql-standards-review skill for reviewing T-SQL against the OLD hSenid HRM or NEW PeoplesHR PHR-X SQL standards, and the phx-dbexplorer MCP server for browsing a SQL Server or Postgres schema. Both moved here from org-standards in its 4.0.0 release; safe to install alongside any other phr-foundry plugin.
